Title: Gene A Characteristics
content: Gene A is a newly discovered gene associated with cellular longevity. It has a total length of 1500 base pairs (bp). This gene is highly expressed in the liver tissues of Methuselah flies.

Title: Gene B Characteristics
content: Gene B is known for its role in metabolic regulation. The coding sequence of Gene B spans exactly 3000 base pairs (bp). It is often studied in conjunction with Gene A.

Title: Protein X Properties
content: Protein X is the primary product of Gene A. It has a molecular weight of 50 kilodaltons (kDa). This protein forms a dimer in its active state.

Title: Protein Y Properties
content: Protein Y interacts with Protein X to regulate cell cycle progression. The molecular weight of Protein Y is recorded at 75 kilodaltons (kDa).
